carrier_contract.aggregation: component-wise arithmetic mean over all block_size*(block_size-1)=552 ordered non-self token pairs; unmatched/missing predicates contribute 0
carrier_contract.concept_token: any exact card candidate for token has empty runtime.operator_bindings
carrier_contract.forms: lemma plus surface_forms; normalize by Unicode NFKC, casefold, strip leading/trailing non-word characters while retaining letters/digits/underscore/hyphen internally
carrier_contract.operator_token: any exact card candidate for token has nonempty runtime.operator_bindings

case_role_link.predicate: one token exposes a nonempty case_gauge field and either token exposes a nonempty role field

operator_argument_link.predicate: exactly one token is operator_token and the other is concept_token

same_event_frame.predicate: token slot-role sets have nonempty intersection

carrier_contract.slot_roles: set of integer slot_id values across exact card candidates

cleaner_contract.markdown_decode: UTF-8 with replacement on decode errors
cleaner_contract.whitespace: collapse all Unicode whitespace runs to one ASCII space and strip

implementation_requirements: commit cleaner source witness before measurement
commit carrier source witness before measurement
commit runner source witness before measurement
commit implementation freeze binding all source witnesses before measurement

probe.training_window_rule: unique rounded equally-spaced starts over concatenated non-heldout cleaned token stream
probe.validation_window_rule: unique rounded equally-spaced starts over concatenated heldout cleaned token stream

purpose: provenance-complete successor to blocked V0.14A and R2; preserve exact source universe, holdouts and carrier admission gate while replacing unavailable helper-byte dependencies with fully specified and subsequently committed source witnesses

source.source_hash_verification: recompute the 109-entry path->SHA256 map from the bound source archive and require exact source_universe_sha256 before any carrier measurement
source.source_universe_commitment: SHA256(canonical JSON object mapping every recovered root docs/**/*.md relative path to raw-file SHA256; json.dumps(sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon)))
